information: ![](https://scontent-cpt1-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t1.6435-9/70003471_108441357202077_8755966770554077184_n.png?_nc_cat=110&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=09cbfe&_nc_ohc=4aN2V_lEohoAX88_D58&_nc_ht=scontent-cpt1-1.xx&oh=00_AT88cgqdTcPLuaRfyObJPcGUGy_nPtp6qvOKegZxah6Ijg&oe=62E91A2B) ![](https://www.speedcubes.co.za/img/speedcubes-logo-1630492151.jpg) Register for the first WCA Speedcubing Competition in Paarl, near Cape Town, South Africa! **COVID-19 Safety Measures** While it is no longer a national requirement to wear a face mask or practice social distancing, we encourage you to sanitize regularly and be respectful of personal space. If you are comfortable wearing a mask, please do so! **Volunteering** We will need your help as volunteers to support with the running and judging of the day. If you would like to volunteer to help staff at the competition, please contact [Maverick Pearson](mpearson@worldcubeassociation.org). Groups will be assigned so that volunteer duties don't clash with your competing. **Cube Shop** Cape Town's own cube shop, [Speedcubes.co.za](https://www.speedcubes.co.za/), will have a stall open at the competition to sell a variety of puzzles. Check out their website to see what's available! **Zero-waste Tuck Shop** There will be a tuck shop open near the school hall with healthy and tasty snacks, coffee, and drinks. There will also be a lunch option that can be booked beforehand. We will share the link to this booking closer to the day via email.
